g.text: Active-task fraction over all returned deployments
Source: independent_v1/main_* only; 90 held-out instances (45 small / 30 medium / 15 large). Seeds averaged within instance, then all 90 instances equally
weighted. 95% bootstrap intervals preserve scale allocation; intervals omitted for constant samples. All runs included; no filtering on feasibility.
